name: Karijuku Tomoe
source: Tomoe is a third-year at Eisui Girls' High School and part of the mahjong team. She plays as the sergeant, and is the most normal person out of her team with no superpowers. She is also kind and level-headed, and is shown to be often caring for [url=/c36714]Komaki[/url].
